items.name: chat
items.title: Chat
items.description: Chat composite block. Layer: Composite Block (`src/components/blocks/`) Foundation: Built strictly from primitives: - `MessageScroller` (`src/components/ui/message-scroller.tsx`) - `ChatMessage` (`src/components/ui/chat-message.tsx`) - `PromptInput` (`src/components/ui/prompt-input.tsx`) - `SuggestionChips` (`src/components/ui/suggestion-chips.tsx`) - `EmptyState` (`src/components/ui/empty-state.tsx`) Specification & Reference: - https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/ai-elements/base/chat - https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/ai-elements/base/prompt-input

taxonomy: Controlled presentational chat workspace assembling the streaming viewport engine, assistant/user messages, suggestion prompts, and message composer.
Supports both Docked (pinned bottom) and Floating Island (centered, floating) prompt positioning.
Supports Model Selection, Reasoning Effort, and Tool Toggles.
Pure UI: receives items via props, emits intents via callbacks. Zero direct fetch or auth.
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant: 44px minimum touch targets on all interactive elements.
Strictly follows DESIGN.md tokens: floating 2px focus ring, semantic high-contrast colors, concentric radius, zero triple-tints.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: DataTable composite block. Layer: Composite Block (`src/components/blocks/`) Foundation: Built strictly from Base UI primitives, TanStack Table, and design tokens: - `Table`, `TableHeader`, `TableBody`, `TableRow`, `TableHead`, `TableCell` (`src/components/ui/table.tsx`) - `Button` (`src/components/ui/button.tsx`) - `Input` (`src/components/ui/input.tsx`) - `Select` (`src/components/ui/select.tsx`) - `Menu` (`src/components/ui/menu.tsx`) - `Checkbox` (`src/components/ui/checkbox.tsx`) - `Badge` (`src/components/ui/badge.tsx`) - `Icon` (`src/components/ui/icon.tsx`) - `@tanstack/react-table`

taxonomy: Enterprise-grade, accessible data table composite block conforming to shadcn/ui Data Table specification.

Powers complex data exploration with column sorting, global & column text filtering, faceted category filtering, row selection, dynamic column visibility toggling, loading/empty states, and accessible pagination.

Conforms to DESIGN.md Table rules: 56px minimum row height, right-aligned numeric columns with tabular-nums and font-mono, concentric geometry, floating focus rings, and container-query responsiveness (@container).

Exports both all-in-one <DataTable /> and composable subcomponents: DataTableColumnHeader, DataTablePagination, DataTableViewOptions, DataTableFacetedFilter, DataTableToolbar, DataTableRowActions, createSelectColumn, createActionsColumn.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: Questionnaire composite block. Layer: Composite Block (`src/components/blocks/`) Foundation: Built strictly from Base UI primitives and design tokens: - `Button` (`src/components/ui/button.tsx`) - `Input` (`src/components/ui/input.tsx`) - `Progress` (`src/components/ui/progress.tsx`) - `Icon` (`src/components/ui/icon.tsx`) - `Kbd` (`src/components/ui/kbd.tsx`)

taxonomy: Multi-step guided question primitive and flow engine for intake forms, clinical assessments, onboarding sequences, configuration wizards, and conversational agent clarification prompts.

Conforms to shadcn/ui Questionnaire specification with full parity across compound subcomponents and flat exports: Root, Progress, Item, Title, Description, Choices, Choice, ChoiceInput, ChoiceLabel, ChoiceShortcut, Input, Error, Actions, Previous, Skip, Next, and Submit.

Supports single-choice, multiple-choice, freeform text entry, keyboard shortcuts (A-Z, 1-9), roving tabindex arrow key navigation, form validation, draft restoration, and native FormData serialization.

Accessible: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant (min-h-11 touch targets), floating 2px focus indicators, fieldset/legend semantics, inert inactive items, live error regions, and container-query responsiveness (@container).

items.name: step-wizard
items.title: Step Wizard
items.description: StepWizard composite block. Layer: Composite Block (`src/components/blocks/`) Foundation: Built strictly from Base UI primitives and design tokens: - `Button`, `UnstyledButton` (`src/components/ui/button.tsx`) - `Icon` (`src/components/ui/icon.tsx`)

taxonomy: Controlled multi-step workflow container for guided clinical intake, onboarding, assessment flows, and multi-stage form sequences.
Pure UI: receives step data via props, manages directional slide transitions, and emits progression intents via callbacks (`onStepChange`, `onComplete`).

Accessible: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 compliant (44x44px minimum touch targets on all interactive step markers and buttons), floating 2px focus indicators (`outline-offset: 2px`), and live regions (`aria-live="polite"`).
Modern HTML integration: supports `hiddenUntilFound` with `hidden="until-found"` and `beforematch` event listener so browser search (<kbd>Ctrl+F</kbd>) finds inactive step content.
